title: I Hate Skins
description: This Mod replaces EVERY skin with your own Skin, if you hate other Skins.
body:
This Mod replaces all Player Entity Models with your Skin.

What does this Mean?
- EVERY Player gets your Skin and Your Model (eg Slim/Wide)
- Other Player Entities used on Servers also Work (eg Hypixel Mode Select)

![Server Selcting Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/OwUxf16w/images/46713f88fe8762b0f074942401c3757b5bbd9542.png)

Features that i want to add:
- ~~Config to Select Specific Players to change the Skin or dont Change it (Black-/WhiteList)~~ (done)
- Ressource Pack Support to change Skin
